title: Skills optimization flight — skills/objectstack-automation: RESTRUCTURE (≈ −1,125 tok net / −2,105 gross) — the package teaches a control-flow trio with zero authorings (`parallel_gateway`/`join_gateway`/`boundary_event`) and never mentions the trio the corpus uses (`parallel`/`try_catch`/`loop`); `notify` (#1 node type, 20 uses) has one table cell; the description still promises ETL pipelines removed in spec 17
body:
Member card of the skills catalog optimization program #14292 (maintainer mandate 2026-09-02, verbatim: 「审核所有的 skills，进行全面的优化。」). Filed by the skills lane seat (session `session_01LraLgQVGq8egUwfYZpbYt1`). Read-only audit at objectstack `origin/main` a59f78d; 25 findings. Full findings table = audit record: the dev posts `audit/objectstack-automation/findings.md` (seat scratchpad) verbatim as the first comment at claim time.

## Audit summary

`SKILL.md` 1,001 lines / 12,768 tok (headroom 0) · `evals/approvals/test-revise-loop.md` 1,329 · `evals/README.md` 414 · generated 835 — package 15,346; all three ratcheted files at zero headroom. Approvals `:296-650` = 5,246 tok = 41% of the file; the highest-density block ("Valid-but-silently-wrong" pitfalls 6–10, `:836-951`) starts at 84% depth. Real usage: 4 `*.flow.ts` + the showcase's 24 flows + jobs + webhooks; zero `*.trigger.ts`. Node-type frequency: `notify` 20, `approval` 15, `screen` 9, `update_record`/`get_record`/`decision` 5, `connector_action` 4, `loop` 3, `try_catch` 2, `parallel` 2, `approval_revise` 1 — `parallel_gateway`/`join_gateway`/`boundary_event` **0**. 14 real patterns; 12 covered; 2 whole `defineStack` collections (`jobs`, `webhooks`) missing. Verdict **RESTRUCTURE**: wrong control-flow model taught; order inverts value; evals orphaned (`grep evals SKILL.md` → 0) and inverted (1,329 tok on the least-used node); the generated index misroutes to the ADR-0020-retired `state-machine.zod.ts`.

## Incidental falsehoods (fix in this flight)

1. `SKILL.md:24-25`, `:35` — "covers … ETL pipelines" / "designing an ETL pipeline": the L2 ETL layer was removed in spec 17 with no replacement (`17.etl-pipeline-layer-retired.ts:7-20`); the package declares 17.x and has zero ETL body content. Also the frontmatter/description (AUTO-A-01).
2. `SKILL.md:791-792` — "Always handle errors. Add `boundary_event` nodes": 0 authorings; the showcase's own waiver (`coverage.ts:299-300`) names `try_catch` and `wait` as the author-facing equivalents.

## Three funded additions

1. Capability → surface table (AUTO-F-02, +40, paid by AUTO-D-06).
2. ADR-0031 structured control-flow rows (AUTO-F-01, +120, paid by AUTO-D-06 + AUTO-D-07).
3. `notify` config fence (AUTO-E-04, +140, paid by AUTO-D-03 + AUTO-D-05) — the 8 keys actually used (`recipients` 13, `title` 10, `topic` 9, `message` 8, `severity` 7, `channels` 7, `sourceObject`/`sourceId` 4, `actionUrl`), schema `io-node-config.zod.ts:179-218`, plus one "Valid-but-silently-wrong" line for the messaging-absent silent success.

## Flight scope

**IMPLEMENT** (shrink-only): rows 1, 3–15 and the findings file at HIGH or MED; the three funded additions; falsehoods 1–2 incl. the description; AUTO-A-02/A-03 (add `jobs`/`webhooks` and screen-flow routing to the description — paid by same-file deletions); AUTO-B-01/B-02 reorder (free — bring the "Valid-but-silently-wrong" block up); link the eval from `SKILL.md`.

**ANCHOR RULINGS**: hooks → `objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` (AUTO-C-02: delete + pointer). The objectstack-query flight points at this package's `:157-164` flow-filter rule — keep that section stable. Screen flows vs views: this package owns screen flows; objectstack-ui points here.

**DEFER**: AUTO-B-04 (eval stub, #14296 item 2); AUTO-B-05 (generator map `build-skill-references.ts:120-129` → out-of-scope card for the spec lane: drop `state-machine.zod.ts`, add `builtin-node-config.zod.ts` / `io-node-config.zod.ts`).

## Flight constraints (binding)

- ONE draft PR, first line `Fixes #<this card>`; governed ⇒ stays draft; review requests are the seat's step.
- Token ratchet: no ratcheted file may grow; additions paid by deletions in the SAME file; ⛔ re-wrap is not payment; ⛔ no ceiling raise; ⛔ no new files; ⛔ do not touch the ratchet script.
- ⛔ Never edit another package's files; follow-ups in the PR body. Generated files untouched. Regenerate the README index only if a drift gate requires it (report which).
- Live surface with zero measured usage ⇒ one row pointing at its schema; retired/tombstoned ⇒ delete. A false claim matching a spec `.describe()` string ⇒ spec-side twin card.
- Gates: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples`, `pnpm check:skill-compatibility`, `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness`, plus `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands <changed paths>`; record the head sha.
- PR body: per-item 落点 | before | after keyed by finding id; per-file token delta; `needs:contract-review` on both carriers (the control-flow rows and the `notify` silent-success semantics are contract claims).

Refs: #14292 · #14296 · #13658.
